common.tagline: Marriage-minded introductions — with witnesses and wali oversight

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.subtitle: You can change it later in settings

landing.title: Getting to know each other — the halal way
landing.subtitle: Hitaba introduces men and women seeking nikah. Every conversation is witnessed, the wali can follow along, and privacy is protected at every step.

mock.msg1: Assalamu alaykum. Could you tell me about your family?
mock.msg2: Wa alaykum assalam. Of course, my father would like to meet as well.
mock.held: A message with contact details was held for the moderator

witnessed.title: Never alone
witnessed.text: Two strangers never talk unwatched. Male and female moderators, an AI assistant and the woman's witnesses are present in every chat.

wali.title: The wali follows
wali.text: The woman shares a private, read-only link with her wali. He can follow the conversation without registering.

privacy.title: Photos under her control
privacy.text: A woman's photo never appears in lists. It opens only by her decision, for 24 hours, with a watermark.

moderation.title: Human moderation
moderation.text: Every profile and photo is checked by a moderator of the same gender. Contact details are blocked until the family stage.

profile.title: Profile
profile.text: Fill in your profile honestly; a moderator reviews it.

match.title: Mutual interest
match.text: When both sides like each other, a match is formed.

photo.title: Photo order
photo.text: The woman sees the man's photo first and decides.

chat.title: Witnessed chat
chat.text: The man opens the chat; everyone watching is visible.

family.title: Family stage
family.text: The mahram contact is shared after moderator approval.

landing.footer: Hitaba · Intention is the foundation of every deed.

auth.registerSubtitle: With the intention of nikah — step by step
auth.adultsOnly: Only for adults (18+) with the intention of nikah.
auth.tgOnlyText: This page works inside the Telegram Mini App. On the web, please sign in with email.

onboarding.rejectedNoReason: Please review your profile and submit it again.

basics.title: About you
basics.why: Your name is shown to others; instead of your exact age, an age range is shown.

location.title: Where you live
location.why: Helps find people close to you or willing to relocate.

family.title: Family status
family.why: Being open from the start builds trust.

about.title: About me
about.why: Describe your character, work and plans. At least 100 characters.

spouse.title: The spouse I seek
spouse.why: What matters to you in a spouse?

beliefs.title: Aqidah, manhaj and scholars
beliefs.why: Agreement in religious understanding is the foundation of a family.

screening.title: Screening questions
screening.why: Seen only by the moderator — never shown to other users.

photos.title: Photos
photos.why: Optional. Up to 3 photos, reviewed by a moderator of your gender.

wali.title: Wali and witnesses
wali.why: Your wali can follow your chats through a private link.

fields.displayNameHint: Do not use your full name or surname.
fields.birthDateHint: Only an age range is shown to others.
fields.polygamy: Are you open to being a second wife?
fields.polygamyHint: Only men who filter for this will see your answer.
fields.beliefsManhajHint: Which scholars do you follow, how do you understand the religion?
fields.screeningPrivacy: These answers are encrypted and visible only to the moderator.
fields.prayer: Do you pray the five daily prayers?
fields.relationsOutsideNikah: Are you currently in a relationship outside nikah?
fields.contagiousDisease: Do you have a contagious disease?
fields.photosFemale: Your photo never appears in lists. A man sees it only after you approve, for 24 hours, with a watermark.
fields.photosMale: The woman sees your photo first. Showing it in the feed is off by default.
fields.acceptRules: I have read and accept the rules

rules.niyyah: I am here only with the intention of nikah.
rules.witnesses: I accept that every conversation is watched by moderators and witnesses.
rules.contact: I will not share phone numbers, usernames or links; contact passes through the mahram after moderator approval.
rules.photos: I will not screenshot, save or share anyone's photos.
rules.respect: I will speak politely and with adab, and keep my intention sincere.
rules.honesty: Everything in my profile is true; duplicate accounts are banned.

photos.hint: Up to {max} photos. Metadata (including location) is removed automatically.

wali.title: Wali and witnesses
wali.intro: Your wali receives a private, read-only link to follow your latest chat. Your witnesses' names are never shown to the other side — only their number and relation.
wali.witnessPrivacy: The other side sees only the number of witnesses and their relation.
wali.linkText: Send this link only to your wali.
wali.revokeConfirm: The current link will stop working immediately. You can create a new one later.

status.pendingText: A moderator will review your profile soon. We will notify you when it is approved.

feed.emptyText: Check back later or widen your filters.
feed.limitReached: You have used today's likes. They renew at midnight in your time zone.
feed.mutualTextSister: You both expressed interest. You can now see his photo and decide.
feed.mutualTextBrother: You both expressed interest. The woman will see your photo and decide.

profile.photoHiddenFemale: Her photo opens only after her approval
profile.photoHiddenMale: Photo becomes visible after mutual interest

likes.emptyMutualText: When someone you liked likes you back, they appear here.

status.requested: You asked him to start the chat
status.waitingBrother: Waiting for the man to open the chat
status.canOpenWindow: You can open the chat · photo visible {h} h

match.sisterDecisionText: You can now see this man's photo. If you approve, he will see your photo for 24 hours and may open a chat. This decision is final.
match.sisterWaitingText: You approved. He can now open a chat.
match.requestChat: Ask him to start the chat
match.brotherWaitingText: The woman will see your photo and decide. You will be notified.
match.sisterRequested: She asked you to start the chat.
match.sisterBusy: She is currently in another chat. You can open a chat when she is free.
match.openChatText: Opening a chat costs {cost} connect. Moderators, the AI assistant and the woman's witnesses will be present.

approve.title: Approve the photo?
approve.text: He will see your photo for {hours} hours and may open a chat. This decision is final.

declinePhoto.title: Not suitable?
declinePhoto.text: The match will be closed. This decision is final.

decline.title: End this match?
decline.text: The match will be closed and cannot be restored.

chats.emptyText: Chats open after mutual interest and the photo stage.

chat.etiquette: This chat is watched by moderators and witnesses. Speak with adab; do not share phone numbers, usernames or links.
chat.heldNote: Held for the moderator — not delivered
chat.pausedBanner: The chat is paused until a moderator reviews a message. This is not a punishment — it protects both sides.
chat.contactWarning: This message seems to contain contact details. It will not be delivered and the chat will pause until a moderator reviews it.
chat.reopenText: {cost} connect will be spent. A chat can be reopened only once.
chat.closeText: The chat will be closed for both sides.

closedBanner.SILENCE: The chat closed automatically after 72 hours of silence.
closedBanner.MODERATOR: The chat was closed by a moderator.
closedBanner.BAN: The chat was closed because an account was blocked.

system.chat_opened: The chat is open. May Allah make it easy.
system.chat_paused_contact: A message was held for review; the chat is paused.
system.chat_resumed: The moderator reviewed it; the chat continues.
system.silence_reminder_2: No messages for 48 hours. The chat will close after 72 hours.
system.chat_closed_silence: The chat was closed due to silence.
system.chat_closed_moderator: The chat was closed by a moderator.

mahram.title: Share mahram contact
mahram.intro: The details are first reviewed by a moderator, then posted in the chat automatically.
mahram.name: Name
mahram.submitted: Sent. It will appear in the chat once a moderator approves it.

report.title: Report
report.thanks: Thank you. The safety team will review it.

myProfile.editHint: Changes to free-text fields are reviewed by a moderator again.
myProfile.remoderation: Your recent changes are being reviewed. Your profile stays visible.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showPhotoInFeed: Show my photo in the feed
settings.showPhotoInFeedHint: Off by default. Women see your photo after mutual interest anyway.
settings.hideBusyBadge: Hide the "in a chat now" badge
settings.hideBusyBadgeHint: Men will not see that you are in a chat.
settings.logoutAllText: All sessions, including this one, will be closed.

wallet.explain: 1 connect = opening 1 chat. Connects never expire and cannot be transferred. If a moderator closes a chat or the other account is blocked, your connect is refunded.
wallet.devNote: Payment with Telegram Stars works inside the Telegram Mini App. In the development environment purchases are simulated.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.segregationNote: Photos are shown only to moderators of the same gender.
admin.reasonHint: Shown to the user. Leave empty to keep it hidden.
admin.auditNote: Every view and decision is logged.
admin.closeRefundNote: The connect spent by the opener is refunded automatically.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, @username or ID
admin.banNote: Ban: all sessions end, balance is reset, open chats close and the other side is refunded.
